title: Pose transfer
description: Gives the person in picture 1 the body pose of the person in picture 2, and keeps picture 1's face, clothes and background as far as FLUX.2 Klein 9B can. Two results from one run: "picture" (the pose picture is a reference, and a language model also writes the pose in words) and "words only" (the model never sees picture 2, so it cannot copy it). The picture size is taken from picture 2 (its latent starts both runs). Each is shown against picture 1 in a Compare Images slider. Good at: simple and medium poses (arms raised, crossed arms, standing or leaning), and keeping the setting. Weak at: extreme poses with a lot of leg or torso change, which can come out odd; picture 2's shoes or clothes can leak in (a ballet slipper on a street shoe); when picture 1 and picture 2 are very different scenes, the "picture" result can copy picture 2's person or background, and then the "words only" result is the safer one (its pose is less exact). Needs a language model that reads images (Describe step). The two sample pictures were made with Fugue (Z-Image Turbo).
